Class Bouncer

java.lang.Object
enemy.Enemy
enemy.Bouncer
public class Bouncer extends Enemy
Enemy that crosses the rooms in a straight line at a constant speed and bounces on the walls, on the invisible barriers and on the other bouncers. It looks like a red neon ring with a turning dashed inner ring and a white dot.
